guard_effect_retry_trace: Run returns immediately if opening the filesystem fails. After successful open it registers defer f.Close before every later return; after successful lock it registers defer unlock. Go defer order releases the lock before closing the filesystem on ordinary return/error or recoverable stack unwinding.

Store.Open creates a new FS and newMemo for that handle. The Engine is allocated within Run with that FS; production openStore is the store.Open function. No daemon/global memo is assigned. Memo lifetime is scoped to the per-call handle reachability, not an explicit memory wipe claim.
Native init-store has its own immediate unlock and is still covered by deferred filesystem close. Failure before a lock is acquired has no acquired unlock obligation.

guard_effect_retry_trace: Generic record.update clones the document, finds the active symbol, keeps its immutable ID, and writes supplied fields before structural validation. It contains no irreversible open-decision transition rule.

The closed open_decision schema allows exactly open/resolved status. Generic apply can therefore move resolved to open if all record fields remain valid. Prepare performs Structural, not Ready; saving an explicitly unresolved draft remains possible.
Ready separately emits OPEN_BLOCKER whenever blocking is true and status is not resolved. The update changes semantic content/revision; invalid structure is rejected before save.
remaining_runtime_assertion_gaps: No existing named assertion found for the complete resolved→open→Ready OPEN_BLOCKER sequence or invalid status preserving the original document. Static schema/control-flow conformance supports the baseline; no runtime test result is invented.

guard_effect_retry_trace: CheckTicket loads the retained content-addressed receipt, checks purpose=context plus exact artifact/task symbol, computes current Context and compares vector_sha256, manifest_sha256 and full delivered offset=len(items). It returns the appropriate error without changing task progress.

The current production Go call graph has no CheckTicket consumer: the only calls outside its definition are two Linux-only direct tests. Ordinary task-start routes to recordWork and does not consult historical CheckTicket.
Retained ticket validation does not grant authority or start work. Changed selection/manifest/offset refuses; no private context-key is used.

guard_effect_retry_trace: Question is a decomposition record type. The closed schema permits open,answered,deferred statuses; knowledgeStructure requires status exactly for question records.
Changing question status to answered requires nonblank answer. Structural validation happens before native save; an answered-without-answer update therefore cannot publish a new canonical revision.
A valid generic update persists the answer and revision via the common transactional save; no user/event receipt is required by this generic record contract.
remaining_runtime_assertion_gaps: No direct existing named answer/nonblank/refusal-preserves-revision assertion found. Source conformance is limited to the closed shape, validator predicate and pre-save ordering.

guard_effect_retry_trace: Promotion is permitted only on work_item records. The closed promotion shape is null or exactly one origin+board_id or origin+WORK-[A-F0-9]{32} work_id form; malformed or non-work-item promotion fails Structural before save.

Generic record.update stores a back-reference through ordinary save. It does not invoke work-create or verify that the cross-store target exists. Cross-store retry/reconciliation is a caller responsibility.

The existing candidate-is-not-published test confirms saving an unpromoted candidate changes neither the legacy board nor promotion field; Python promotion adapters separately own actual work creation and idempotent repair.

guard_effect_retry_trace: CLI calls operations.Run before serializing the success envelope. It marshals that envelope, selects default65536 or a present request budget, and rejects encoded length+newline above the limit with RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE.

The size check precedes stdout success write but follows Run. Therefore its error does not establish rollback or absence of a completed mutation. Recovery/operation identity remains authoritative for uncertain acknowledgement.
Native source is unchanged for this wrapper; the one CLI named test only proves a JSON public fault and matching unknown-operation exit classification.

guard_effect_retry_trace: After passing encoding/budget checks, CLI writes the success JSON plus newline once. A returned stdout write error yields exit5; successful writes proceed to ordinary exit0 or validation exit2 as applicable.
There is no rollback on acknowledgement write failure. Run may already have committed; the caller must inspect/retry the same operation ID according to native recovery state.
The public-fault helper has a separate best-effort write; it is not the successful acknowledgement branch being preserved here.

intentional_change.explicit_receipt_contract_note: Current RequestSchema task-reconcile has optional receipt, required exact task/state/reason and CAS. Only a present receipt selects the retained authority.Load/Subject/input/task/target/TaskFresh path. A missing receipt selects ordinary recordWork; no receipt gate is reintroduced for ordinary progress.
